task_instance: Scaffold the Expo native shell (skill step 2, 'create-expo-app') for a small sample web React app, as the minimal representative slice of the web-to-native migration this skill orchestrates.
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable is an end-to-end web-to-native migration whose very first mechanical step is 'create-expo-app' to scaffold the Expo project. This requires fetching the create-expo-app package (and, once scaffolded, expo/expo-router/react-native and dependencies) from the npm registry. Running `npx --offline --yes create-expo-app@latest MyApp --template blank` failed immediately with `npm error code ENOTCACHED / request to https://registry.npmjs.org/create-expo-app failed: cache mode is 'only-if-cached' but no cached response is available`, confirming no local/offline path exists to materialize even the empty shell. `npm ls -g --depth=0` also shows no expo/react-native/create-expo-app tooling pre-installed on the machine. Beyond scaffolding, later mandatory steps need capabilities this workstation categorically lacks and that the skill explicitly refuses to substitute for: a real iOS/Android environment or Expo Go/simulator to run the app on, and the skill's required verification tools `agent-browser` (to snapshot the running web app) and `argent` (to drive the native simulator) -- neither binary exists on this machine (`which agent-browser argent` returned nothing), and the skill says explicitly 'if agent-browser or argent isn't installed, ask the user and install it before proceeding -- don't fall back to manual screenshots'. Every one of these (npm registry fetch, package installs, simulators, agent-browser/argent) requires network access and/or installing new software, both of which are forbidden in this air-gapped runtime. There is no way to produce or verify the skill's actual deliverable (a running native app migrated from a web app) without them.
evidence: Commands run (all under the work directory): `which node npm npx python3 git` (all present); `node -v` -> v22.22.2, `npm -v` -> 10.9.7; `npm ls -g --depth=0` shows only generic dev tooling (typescript, eslint, playwright, etc.) with no expo/react-native/create-expo-app; `which agent-browser argent` -> empty (neither installed); `timeout 60 npx --offline --yes create-expo-app@latest MyApp --template blank` -> failed with `npm error code ENOTCACHED` / `request to https://registry.npmjs.org/create-expo-app failed: cache mode is 'only-if-cached' but no cached response is available`, i.e. scaffolding is impossible without a live network fetch. No project files, native shell, or migrated screens could be produced or verified because the very first step of the migration (scaffold the Expo shell) is blocked, and the mandated verification tooling (agent-browser, argent) is also absent and uninstallable offline.
